estilo_base: Children's picture book illustration, soft painterly digital art with gentle textures, rounded friendly shapes, expressive faces, warm cozy autumn mood with playful neon sci-fi glow accents. Palette: pumpkin orange (#F28C28), deep night purple (#3B2A5C), moss green (#6B8F47), cream (#F6EBD9), with lime glow (#9BF26B) and soft cyan (#5FD4E8) for alien technology. Warm rim lighting, night scenes lit by porch lights, lanterns and moonlight, never dark or scary. No text, no letters, no words in the image.

fijos: 7-year-old girl, small for her age
round face, warm tan skin (#C68B5E), light freckles across her nose
big dark brown eyes (#4A2C1A), thick eyebrows
one missing front tooth when she smiles
dark brown hair (#2B1B12), shoulder length, in two puffy pigtails tied with orange scrunchies (#F28C28)
personajes.ropa: Mustard-yellow hoodie (#E8B33A) with a small round rocket patch on the chest, dark teal leggings (#2F6F73), white sneakers; red rain boots (#C8382E) in the garden; plaid pajamas (blue and cream) in the morning scenes.
personajes.disfraz: Astronaut costume she made herself: a shiny silver cardboard-box helmet covered in uneven silver duct tape, a round hole for her face and two small air holes, slightly too big and tilted; a white hoodie with hand-drawn star and planet patches.
personajes.expresiones: Curious wide eyes, a determined little frown when she's brave, a big gap-toothed grin when happy.
negativos: hair is never blonde or loose: always two pigtails
the helmet is always a cardboard box, never a real glass space helmet
personajes.base: Mari, a small 7-year-old girl with warm tan skin, light freckles, big dark brown eyes, a missing front tooth, and dark brown hair in two puffy pigtails tied with orange scrunchies, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with a small rocket patch and dark teal leggings

fijos: about the size of a house cat (30 cm)
round jelly-bean-shaped body, a little wider at the bottom, no neck
soft lavender-purple skin (#A98BE0), slightly glossy, with a lighter lilac belly (#D9CCF5)
two big round glossy navy eyes (#1C1A3A) with tiny star-shaped sparkles
rosy cheeks, small smiling mouth, no teeth
two tiny stubby arms with three fingers each, NO legs
three thin springy antennae on top of its head, each ending in a small glowing bulb
floats a few inches above the ground with a faint lime glow underneath
personajes.ropa: No clothes. Sometimes borrows things: a too-big pirate hat (ch. 3).
personajes.disfraz: On Halloween night it goes 'dressed as Zib' (no costume) with a tiny orange candy bucket.
personajes.expresiones: Antenna bulbs change color with its mood: yellow = a glow-seed is close (antennae point toward it), pink = happy or shy, blue = excited, gray and drooping = sad, rainbow = very happy. Bubbly, bobbing, sometimes floats upside down.
negativos: always exactly two eyes and exactly three antennae
never has legs, wings or teeth
must not look like E.T., minions, Mike Wazowski or any existing character
personajes.base: Zib, a small cute alien about the size of a house cat with a round jelly-bean-shaped lavender-purple body, a lighter lilac belly, two big round glossy navy eyes with tiny star sparkles, rosy cheeks, two tiny three-fingered arms, no legs, and three thin springy antennae with small glowing bulbs, floating a few inches above the ground

fijos: small, slim black short-haired cat
big round amber-yellow eyes (#F2C230)
small pink nose, a tiny white spot on her chest
long thin tail
personajes.disfraz: Halloween night: tiny purple felt bat wings strapped on her back.
personajes.expresiones: Usually startled: fur puffed up, eyes huge, hiding in funny places (inside a rain boot, behind a watering can) with only eyes or tail showing. Brave pose only in chapter 11.
negativos: always looks funny-scared, never fierce or creepy
personajes.base: Pepper, a small slim black cat with big round amber-yellow eyes, a pink nose and a tiny white spot on her chest

fijos: Mexican grandmother around 68, short and round
warm brown skin (#A86B47) with deep smile lines
silver-gray hair in a low bun held with a wooden hair clip
small gold hoop earrings
no glasses
personajes.ropa: Dark green dress (#3F6B4E), a cream apron embroidered with small colorful flowers, a turquoise rebozo shawl with thin pink stripes (#2BA7A0, #E2557A), comfy brown shoes.
personajes.disfraz: None; on Halloween she wears a headband with small orange marigold flowers.
personajes.expresiones: Big warm smile, calm and never scared; often holding a cup of cinnamon tea or a basket of pan dulce.
personajes.base: Abuela Lupe, a short, round Mexican grandmother with warm brown skin, smile lines, silver-gray hair in a low bun with a wooden clip and small gold hoop earrings, wearing a dark green dress, a flowered cream apron and a turquoise rebozo shawl with thin pink stripes

fijos: very tall and thin woman around 75
pale skin (#F1D3C2) with rosy cheeks
long silver hair in a single braid over one shoulder
small round wire-rimmed glasses
personajes.ropa: A very big floppy wide-brimmed black hat (round top, NOT pointy) with a small brass star pin, a long dark plum cardigan (#5A2E5E) over a gray dress with tiny moon prints, a mustard scarf.
personajes.disfraz: Same outfit (she says the hat is her costume every year).
personajes.expresiones: Looks serious and a little grumpy when resting; when she smiles her whole face lights up and her glasses ride up on her cheeks. Often holds a lantern or a star map.
personajes.base: Mrs. Crump, a very tall thin elderly woman with pale rosy-cheeked skin, a long silver braid and small round wire glasses, wearing a huge floppy round-topped black hat with a brass star pin and a long plum cardigan over a gray moon-print dress

fijos: 7-year-old boy, a bit taller than Mari
deep brown skin (#6B4226)
short black curly hair
big grin, dimples
personajes.ropa: Green-and-white striped long-sleeve shirt, jeans, red sneakers.
personajes.disfraz: Halloween night: a knight with a cardboard shield painted with a pumpkin and a silver foil helmet.
personajes.expresiones: Easily amazed, mouth open in a big 'whoa'.
personajes.base: Leo, a 7-year-old boy with deep brown skin, short black curly hair and dimples, wearing a green-and-white striped long-sleeve shirt, jeans and red sneakers

fijos: young woman in her thirties
warm brown skin
long black hair in a low ponytail
personajes.ropa: Teal cardigan over a cream blouse, small pumpkin earrings.
personajes.base: Ms. Patel, a young teacher with warm brown skin and long black hair in a low ponytail, wearing a teal cardigan and small pumpkin earrings

personajes.nombre: La nave calabaza y las semillas de luz
fijos: pumpkin spaceship as big as an armchair (about 80 cm)
perfectly round, smooth, glossy bright orange (#F28C28) with soft ridges
a thin seam all around its middle where the top lifts like a lid
a short silver metal stem on top
one small round porthole on its side glowing lime green (#9BF26B)
inside: a tiny cushioned seat, round glowing buttons and a clear glass jar with 8 round holes like an egg carton
glow-seeds: marble-sized round seeds glowing bright lime green
personajes.expresiones: Hums softly; glows more as it gets more seeds.
negativos: not a real vegetable inside (no goo)
personajes.base: the pumpkin spaceship: an armchair-sized, perfectly round, glossy bright orange pumpkin with a seam around its middle, a short silver metal stem and a small round porthole glowing lime green
